title: holoportation: virtual 3D teleportation in real-time (Microsoft Research)
summary: Microsoft Research demonstrates holoportation, which reconstructs and compresses high-quality 3D models of people in real time and sends them anywhere. With a HoloLens, remote participants appear as if present in your room.
why: Cited as the benchmark demo for telepresence and photorealistic avatars, in discussions of remote work and VR.

quote.text: Holoportation looks very neat I really hope I get to try it one day.
